# Prompt Ustad

> Prompt Ustad is a free, rule-based prompt builder founded and built by Mudassir Khan. It helps students, educators, freelancers and everyday users organise a rough request into an editable prompt in English or Roman Urdu.

## What it does

- Structures a request into a task, context, audience, format and constraints.
- Lets users review and edit each prompt block before copying or downloading.
- Includes examples, writing guides and a follow-up prompt builder.
- Works in a browser and keeps drafts in that browser’s local storage.

## Limits and accuracy

- Prompt Ustad does not call an AI model, generate an answer, translate the original brief or verify facts.
- Users choose which AI tool to use and should review its output.
- The product is free to use; there are no paid plans, subscriptions or locked exports in the current version.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://mudassirkhan081.github.io/prompt-ustad/): product overview and frequently asked questions.
- [Free prompt studio](https://mudassirkhan081.github.io/prompt-ustad/studio.html): create and edit a prompt.
- [Prompt examples](https://mudassirkhan081.github.io/prompt-ustad/examples.html): editable examples for work and learning.
- [Prompt writing guides](https://mudassirkhan081.github.io/prompt-ustad/guides.html): practical guidance and linked tutorials.
- [Free AI prompt builder for students](https://mudassirkhan081.github.io/prompt-ustad/student-prompt-builder.html): study prompts for explanations, practice and revision plans.
- [Roman Urdu prompt guide](https://mudassirkhan081.github.io/prompt-ustad/guides-roman-urdu-prompts.html): preserve Roman Urdu input and choose the response language.
- [About](https://mudassirkhan081.github.io/prompt-ustad/about.html): creator, product scope and contact details.
- [Privacy](https://mudassirkhan081.github.io/prompt-ustad/privacy.html): browser storage and analytics details.
- [Terms](https://mudassirkhan081.github.io/prompt-ustad/terms.html): terms of use.
